name: Mark of Order gains a stack every second (#2291)
contract: Mark of Order 806269's tooltip is "Increases the healing of your next Reverse Wound on the target by $s2% for $d. Every $t1 sec for the duration, they gain an additional stack of this effect, up to $u". Spell.dbc gives 806269 StackAmount 5 and effect 0 Aura=23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with EffectAmplitude 1000 on 806270 "Add stack", so one stack must be added every second up to five. 806270's single effect is Effect=175 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_STACKS) with EffectTriggerSpell 806269, EffectMiscValue 0 and EffectMiscValueB 1: Spell::EffectAscensionModifyAuraStacks passes effect.MiscValue as the delta and ModifyAscensionAuraStacks returns immediately on a zero delta, so the growth never happened. The fixture applies the Mark directly rather than earning it through Fortify Timeline, because the application half is covered by chronomancer-mark-of-order.json; this scenario covers only the per-second growth. Nothing else in the tree adds a stack of 806269, so an aura that is still at one stack after several seconds is the unrepaired record.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture one stack of Mark of Order, as Fortify Timeline's heal would leave it
The Mark is present before any periodic tick
Mark of Order grows past its first stack on its own periodic ticks
